name: LAS

source_types: LAS 2.0 well log files (depth indexed), with optional Petrel deviation (.dev) files

limitations: Only LAS 2.0 is supported; time/index-indexed files are rejected.
One hole per LAS file; the ~Other section is ignored.
Collar and survey need a Petrel deviation (.dev) file per hole, otherwise a (0, 0, 0) collar and a vertical path are used.
Deviation files are assumed to be in metres.
